comment: Material presets for painting in Aseprite (pc/tools/material_presets.py): paint a swatch on the Material layer and the bridge sets the metal and roughness maps from it. CC0, no game data. Add or override presets in the user file (pc/user/lighting/paint-presets.json, $ROOD_PAINT_PRESETS_USER): an entry with the same id replaces this one, a new id adds a swatch, "disabled": true drops one. colour: a distinct swatch (never a gray), metal and roughness 0..1; other channels (height, emissive, alpha...) can be added to a preset later and are carried as they are.

presets.name: Rusted iron
presets.notes: corroded: mostly oxide, a little bare metal
